gap: No result ChatGPT got lists a BLUETTI Elite 400 kit (3,840 Wh with 350 to 700 W of panels, $1,756.55 to $2,325.60 through our link, pre-order to mid-January 2027), or says that on 2026-11-18 the DELTA Pro 3 is absent from EcoFlow's store search, the F3800 Plus is sold out, and Jackery's black 3600 Plus and 5000 Plus are pre-orders.
standout_why: Compared against the three cited pages (PowerSized DELTA Pro 3 review, StormWatts 240 V solar-input page, StormWatts bundle-vs-separate page) and the top-ranked StormWatts same-panel-watts kit page. PowerSized already says the DELTA Pro 3 and its kits are out of stock at EcoFlow (Nov 5 and Nov 17), and the StormWatts 240 V page already has the F3800 Plus sold out, so the stock half is only partly new. None of the four mentions the Elite 400. The StormWatts kit page's largest battery is 3,763 Wh, the bundle page stops at October 16 prices with no ship dates, and no page puts a 4 kWh-class kit under $2,000.
decides: It changes the value pick, with two caveats. ChatGPT's top pick (DELTA Pro 3 + 400 W, about $3,099 from October) did not appear in EcoFlow's US store search today. The Elite 400 + 2× 200 W is $1,804.05 through our link for 3,840 Wh, about $1,295 less than that October price, but it is a pre-order to mid-January 2027 and its 2,600 W AC output is below the 3,000 W ChatGPT asked for. I could not confirm any kit inside 3,200 to 4,800 Wh as shipping now. The nearest ship-now kits we link are the ALLPOWERS R3500 + 400 W ($1,586.73) and + 600 W ($1,753.93), at 3,168 Wh, which is 20.8% under 4,000 Wh; whether that counts as 'about 20%' is the page owner's call. Jackery's 3600 Plus kit may ship sooner than the Elite 400 (station Dec 15 or the in-stock Red Cross Edition, panels Dec 5), but I could not read its kit price today. The page is not a skip: four Elite 400 kits fit the size line.
